dad/welcome.say: Three boxes in the truck with your name on 'em. Your room's the last one. End of the hall.
dad/welcome.html: Dad: Three boxes in the truck with your name on 'em. Your room's the last one. End of the hall.

dad/line_1.say: Watch the second step. It's soft.
dad/line_1.html: Dad: Watch the second step. It's soft.

dad/line_2.say: Truck goes back at six. ...Just keep moving, bud.
dad/line_2.html: Dad: Truck goes back at six. Just keep moving, bud.

dad/line_3.say: Bunk was already in there when we came. Top one's yours.
dad/line_3.html: Dad: Bunk was already in there when we came. Top one's yours.

dad/mom_looking.say: That's all of yours. Go see your mom.
dad/mom_looking.html: Dad: That's all of yours. Go see your mom.

mom/boxes_again.say: Boxes, bud. Then I'm all yours.
mom/boxes_again.html: Mom: Boxes, bud. Then I'm all yours.

mom/helper.say: That's all of them? ...Okay. Sheets are in a box somewhere. Sleeping bag tonight.
mom/helper.html: Mom: That's all of them? Okay. Sheets are in a box somewhere. Sleeping bag tonight.

mom/landlord.say: Landlord said don't mind the noises. Old house. ...He said it twice.
mom/landlord.html: Mom: Landlord said don't mind the noises. Old house. ...He said it twice.

dad/leftovers.say: People before us left in a hurry. Back room's still full of their stuff.
dad/leftovers.html: Dad: People before us left in a hurry. Back room's still full of their stuff.

mom/teeth.say: Teeth, then bed. Door stays open. Hall light stays on. ...Okay?
mom/teeth.html: Mom: Teeth, then bed. Door stays open. Hall light stays on. Okay?

you/m1_a.html: You: Something got in the bottom bunk last night.

mom/m1_a.say: I heard you talking. I came in. ...It sounded like two people, bud.
mom/m1_a.html: Mom: I heard you talking. I came in. It sounded like two people, bud.

dad/m1_a.say: [flat, tired] I put that box out by the road last night. It's back in your room.
dad/m1_a.html: Dad: I put that box out by the road last night. It's back in your room.

dad/n2_a.say: [whispering, angry] He's doing it for attention. You baby him and he knows it.
dad/n2_a.html: Through the wall, your dad: He's doing it for attention. You baby him and he knows it.

mom/n2_a.say: [whispering, tired] Then why did he draw that thing on the wall?
mom/n2_a.html: Your mom: Then why did he draw that thing on the wall?

you/m2_a.html: You: It was in my room. It stood right next to my bed. It was smiling.

mom/m2_a.say: In your room. Standing there. ...Smiling. Okay. Did it, um... did it say anything?
mom/m2_a.html: Mom: In your room. Standing there. Smiling. Okay. Did it say anything?

dad/m2_a.say: [low, angry] That's enough. I am not doing this every morning. You want attention, you ask for it. You don't make up monsters.
dad/m2_a.html: Dad: That's enough. I am not doing this every morning. You want attention, you ask for it. You don't make up monsters.

mom/m2_b.say: Hey. Don't look at me like that. There's nothing in this house but us and a lot of boxes. Toast. Eat.
mom/m2_b.html: Mom: Hey. Don't look at me like that. There's nothing in this house but us and a lot of boxes. Toast. Eat.

mom/n3_a.say: [whispering, frightened] Did you hear that? Mark. Mark, there's someone in the hall.
mom/n3_a.html: Your mom, through the wall: Did you hear that? Mark. Mark, there's someone in the hall.

dad/n3_a.say: [whispering, groggy] Go back to sleep. It's the kid.
dad/n3_a.html: Your dad: Go back to sleep. It's the kid.

dad/lure_a.say: [soft, tired, a little sad] Hey, bud. Can't sleep either? C'mere. Come sit with me.
dad/lure_a.html: Dad: Hey, bud. Can't sleep either? C'mere. Come sit with me.

dad/lure_b.say: [warm, quiet] Come on. It's okay. I saved you a spot.
dad/lure_b.html: Dad: Come on. It's okay. I saved you a spot.

mom/mimic_a.say: [gentle, sleepy] Sweetheart? Can you come here a second?
mom/mimic_a.html: Mom: Sweetheart? Can you come here a second?

mom/mimic_b.say: [soft, patient] Honey, I need you in the kitchen. Right now. Please.
mom/mimic_b.html: Mom: Honey, I need you in the kitchen. Right now. Please.

mom/mimic_c.say: [flat, wrong, too slow] Why are you running?

dad/mutter_a.say: [muffled through a wall, half asleep] It's the pipes. It's an old house. Go back to sleep.
dad/mutter_a.html: Dad: (through the wall) It's the pipes. It's an old house. Go back to sleep.

mom/mutter_a.say: [muffled through a wall, uneasy] Did you hear that?
mom/mutter_a.html: Mom: (through the wall) Did you hear that?

dad/mutter_b.say: [muffled through a wall, irritated] I said it's nothing.
dad/mutter_b.html: Dad: (through the wall) I said it's nothing.

mom/mutter_b.say: [muffled through a wall, whispering] Something's in the house. I know it. I can feel it.
mom/mutter_b.html: Mom: (through the wall) Something's in the house. I can feel it.

you/m3_a.say: It was in the hall again. I saw it.
you/m3_a.html: You: It was in the hall again. I saw it.

mom/m3_a.say: Sweetheart... three nights, three different things. I'm not mad. I just need you to hear how that sounds.
mom/m3_a.html: Mom: Sweetheart. Three nights, three different things. I'm not mad. I just need you to hear how that sounds.

dad/m3_a.say: [flat, irritated] Eat your cereal. We've got a lot to unpack and I'm not doing this at seven in the morning.
dad/m3_a.html: Dad: Eat your cereal. We've got a lot to unpack and I'm not doing this at seven in the morning.

mom/m4_a.say: I was putting your shirts away this morning. There's scratches inside your closet door. Down low... about your height.
mom/m4_a.html: Mom: I was putting your shirts away this morning. There are scratches inside your closet door. Down low. About your height.

dad/m4_a.say: [dismissive] Mice. Or the last kid. Kids scratch things. I'll sand it down this weekend.
dad/m4_a.html: Dad: Mice. Or the last kid. Kids scratch things. I'll sand it down this weekend.

dad/m5_a.say: [tired, haunted] I didn't sleep either. Woke up around three. Swear I heard somebody walking the hall.
dad/m5_a.html: Dad: I didn't sleep either. Woke up around three. Swear I heard somebody walking the hall.

mom/m5_a.say: That was me. I got up for the bathroom.
mom/m5_a.html: Mom: That was me. I got up for the bathroom.

dad/m5_b.say: [slowly] No. This was heavier than you.
dad/m5_b.html: Dad: No. This was heavier than you.

mom/m5_b.say: Not at the table, okay? Not in front of him.
mom/m5_b.html: Mom: Not at the table, okay? Not in front of him.

mom/m6_a.say: I'm calling the landlord today. I don't care what it costs. Something's wrong with this house, and I'm done pretending it isn't.
mom/m6_a.html: Mom: I'm calling the landlord today. I don't care what it costs. Something's wrong with this house, and I'm done pretending it isn't.

dad/m6_a.say: [bitter] And say what? That the ghost is raising the rent? We signed a year lease. We put every dime into this move.
dad/m6_a.html: Dad: And say what? That the ghost is raising the rent? We signed a year lease. We put every dime into this move.

mom/m6_b.say: Then we find the money somewhere else. We always do.
mom/m6_b.html: Mom: Then we find the money somewhere else. We always do.

dad/m7_a.say: [hoarse] I sat up with every light on last night. Right there on the couch. Nothing came.
dad/m7_a.html: Dad: I sat up with every light on last night. Right there on the couch. Nothing came.

you/m7_a.say: It doesn't come when you're watching.
you/m7_a.html: You: It doesn't come when you're watching.

dad/m7_b.say: [a beat, then low] ...Because he's right. It waits. I felt it waiting.
dad/m7_b.html: Dad: ...Because he's right. It waits. I felt it waiting.

mom/m8_a.say: I'm sleeping in your room tonight. Don't argue with me, mister.
mom/m8_a.html: Mom: I'm sleeping in your room tonight. Don't argue with me, mister.

dad/m8_a.say: [ashamed] I put a chair against our door last night. Like that would do anything.
dad/m8_a.html: Dad: I put a chair against our door last night. Like that would do anything.

mom/m8_b.say: Two more nights. That's it. Then we're gone, lease or no lease.
mom/m8_b.html: Mom: Two more nights. That's it. Then we're gone, lease or no lease.

mom/m9_a.say: Trunk's packed. Everything that matters. First light, we're gone. No matter what.
mom/m9_a.html: Mom: Trunk's packed. Everything that matters. First light, we're gone. No matter what.

dad/m9_a.say: [quiet] I called my brother. He'll put us up. I should have listened to you on day one, buddy.
dad/m9_a.html: Dad: I called my brother. He'll put us up. I should have listened to you on day one, buddy.

mom/m9_b.say: One more night. Stay close to us, okay?
mom/m9_b.html: Mom: One more night. Stay close to us, okay?

mom/t_thirst.say: [puzzled] The kitchen tap was running when I came down. I know I shut it off.
mom/t_thirst.html: Mom: The kitchen tap was running when I came down. I know I shut it off.

dad/t_ring.say: [uneasy] I called the phone company. They say no call came in last night. Not one.
dad/t_ring.html: Dad: I called the phone company. They say no call came in last night. Not one.

dad/t_static.say: [uneasy] The TV was on static when I came down. I unplugged it. It was still on.
dad/t_static.html: Dad: The TV was on static when I came down. I unplugged it. It was still on.

mom/t_mimic.say: [frightened] I never called for you last night. I was asleep. I swear to God.
mom/t_mimic.html: Mom: I never called for you last night. I was asleep. I swear to God.

dad/t_blackout.say: [confused] The breaker was flipped. Nobody flips a breaker from the inside.
dad/t_blackout.html: Dad: The breaker was flipped. Nobody flips a breaker from the inside.

mom/t_hunted.say: [worried] You're shaking. Look at your knees. When did you do that?
mom/t_hunted.html: Mom: You're shaking. Look at your knees. When did you do that?

mom/t_paralysis.say: [hushed] I came in to check on you. Your eyes were open. You didn't blink. You didn't answer me.
mom/t_paralysis.html: Mom: I came in to check on you. Your eyes were open. You didn't blink. You didn't answer me.

mom/t_teddy.say: [quiet] Your bear was in the middle of the hall this morning. Don't tell me you put it there.
mom/t_teddy.html: Mom: Your bear was in the middle of the hall this morning. Don't tell me you put it there.

mom/t_parents.say: [haunted] I dreamed somebody was standing over our bed. And when I woke up, our door was open.
mom/t_parents.html: Mom: I dreamed somebody was standing over our bed. And when I woke up, our door was open.

dad/t_quiet.say: [low] Did it feel... wrong, to you? How quiet it got last night?
dad/t_quiet.html: Dad: Did it feel... wrong, to you? How quiet it got last night?

mom/t_car.say: [soft, strange] You said something in your sleep. You said, 'don't open the glove box.' What does that mean?
mom/t_car.html: Mom: You said something in your sleep. You said, 'don't open the glove box.' What does that mean?

mom/f_a.say: [screaming, raw terror] I SEE IT. OH MY GOD, I SEE IT.
mom/f_a.html: Mom: I SEE IT. OH MY GOD, I SEE IT.

mom/car_a.say: [bright, a little too cheerful] Seatbelt, sweetie. We're almost there.

dad/car_a.say: [relaxed, driving] Milk, bread, whatever's on your mother's list. Twenty minutes, tops.
dad/car_a.html: Dad: Milk, bread, whatever's on your mother's list. Twenty minutes, tops.

mom/car_b.say: [quietly, to Dad] He hasn't said a word since we got in the car.
mom/car_b.html: Mom: He hasn't said a word since we got in the car.

mom/car_c.say: [gentle, flat, wrong] We are home, honey. We're always home.
mom/car_c.html: Mom: We are home, honey. We're always home.

dad/car_c.say: [tense, jaw tight] Come on. Come ON. Move.

mom/car_d.say: [soft, distant] Shh. Look out the window, sweetheart. Count the cars.
mom/car_d.html: Mom: Shh. Look out the window, sweetheart. Count the cars.

mom/car_e.say: [far away, from outside, sweet] Honey? We're home.

gramps/v_a.say: [old, soft, slow] Hey there, kiddo. Come sit with me a minute. The light's better over here.
gramps/v_a.html: Grandpa: Hey there, kiddo. Come sit with me a minute. The light's better over here.

gramps/v_b.say: [low, wet, not quite his voice] Look at me, Bud. Look at me. Don't you know who I am?
gramps/v_b.html: Grandpa: Look at me, Bud. Look at me. Don't you know who I am?

dad/talk_a.say: [muffled through a wall, low and tired] It was the pipes again. I checked. There's nothing in the house.
dad/talk_a.html: Dad: (through the wall) It was the pipes again. I checked. There's nothing in the house.

mom/talk_a.say: [muffled through a wall, whispering] Then why is it standing outside the door every night?
mom/talk_a.html: Mom: (through the wall) Then why is it standing outside the door every night?

mom/talk_b.say: [muffled through a wall, a tight whisper] He keeps drawing it. Did you see what he drew?
mom/talk_b.html: Mom: (through the wall) He keeps drawing it. Did you see what he drew?

dad/talk_b.say: [muffled through a wall, slow, worried] Kids draw things. Come back to bed. Please.
dad/talk_b.html: Dad: (through the wall) Kids draw things. Come back to bed. Please.

dad/talk_c.say: [muffled through a wall, hushed] Don't look at the window. Just keep your eyes shut.
dad/talk_c.html: Dad: (through the wall) Don't look at the window. Just keep your eyes shut.

mom/talk_c.say: [muffled through a wall, barely a breath] Somebody just walked past our door.
mom/talk_c.html: Mom: (through the wall) Somebody just walked past our door.

dad/phone_a.say: [muffled, low, flat, like he is talking on the phone] Yeah. He's asleep. They're all asleep. Come in through the back.
dad/phone_a.html: Dad: (through the wall) Yeah. He's asleep. They're all asleep. Come in through the back.

mom/ph_low_a.say: Honey... it's a dark picture of a door. Eat your toast.
mom/ph_low_a.html: Mom: Honey. It's a dark picture of a door. Eat your toast.

mom/ph_low_b.say: Where did you even get film for that thing? Not at the table.
mom/ph_low_b.html: Mom: Where did you even get film for that thing? Not at the table.

dad/ph_low_a.say: Bud, that's a shadow. The flash does that.
dad/ph_low_a.html: Dad: Bud, that's a shadow. The flash does that.

dad/ph_low_b.say: You were up taking pictures at three in the morning? Well, there's your problem.
dad/ph_low_b.html: Dad: You were up taking pictures at three in the morning? Well, there's your problem.

mom/ph_mid_b.say: That wasn't there yesterday. Was it?
mom/ph_mid_b.html: Mom: That wasn't there yesterday. Was it?

dad/ph_mid_a.say: Huh. Let me see that again.
dad/ph_mid_a.html: Dad: Huh. Let me see that again.

dad/ph_mid_b.say: Okay. Don't touch it. I'll look at it when I get home.
dad/ph_mid_b.html: Dad: Okay. Don't touch it. I'll look at it when I get home.

mom/ph_high_a.say: [quiet] Mark. Look at this. Look at it.
mom/ph_high_a.html: Mom: Mark. Look at this. Look at it.

mom/ph_high_b.say: Put it away. Please. I can't look at it.
mom/ph_high_b.html: Mom: Put it away. Please. I can't look at it.

dad/ph_high_a.say: [quiet] ...I heard it too. I didn't want to say.
dad/ph_high_a.html: Dad: ...I heard it too. I didn't want to say.

dad/ph_high_b.say: Nobody goes anywhere alone tonight. Nobody.
dad/ph_high_b.html: Dad: Nobody goes anywhere alone tonight. Nobody.

dad/call_a.html: Dad: (somewhere in the house) Bud? ...C'mere a sec.

dad/call_b.html: Dad: (somewhere in the house) Hey. You up? Come here.

dad/call_c.say: [quiet] In the kitchen, bud. Come on.
dad/call_c.html: Dad: (from the kitchen) In the kitchen, bud. Come on.

dad/call_f.say: [very quiet] I'm right here. Don't turn the light on.
dad/call_f.html: Dad: I'm right here. Don't turn the light on.

news/n1.say: And in local news tonight, the house at the end of Larch Road has new tenants, the first in six years. Neighbors say the family before them left in the middle of the night. They did not take their furniture. No report was ever filed.
news/n1.html: (the TV) ...the house at the end of Larch Road has new tenants, the first in six years...

news/n2.say: Eleven years ago this week, a seven-year-old boy went missing from his bedroom on Larch Road. His parents told investigators he had said something was standing at the foot of his bed. The case remains open.
news/n2.html: (the TV) ...a seven-year-old boy went missing from his bedroom on Larch Road...

news/n3.say: Drivers on County Road Nine are asked to use caution tonight after a deer was found lying in the road. Animal control says it had not been hit by a car. They would not say what had happened to it.
news/n3.html: (the TV) ...a deer was found lying in the road. It had not been hit by a car...

news/n4.say: Several homes on Larch Road are without power tonight. The utility says its crews found nothing wrong with the lines. Residents are asked to stay inside, keep their doors shut, and not to answer if someone calls them by name.
news/n4.html: (the TV) ...and not to answer if someone calls them by name.

news/n5.say: Overnight, fog in the low places, and a low near thirty-eight. Sunrise at six-oh-two. For anyone still awake out on Larch Road, it will not be long now.
news/n5.html: (the TV) ...for anyone still awake out on Larch Road, it will not be long now.

news/n6.say: We have a late report from the house at the end of Larch Road. A boy has been awake since three. He has been walking the hall. He went into the kitchen. He did not turn on the light.
news/n6.html: (the TV) ...a boy has been awake since three. He has been walking the hall...

news/n7.say: He is in the living room now. He is standing in front of the television. He is listening to this. ... Go back to bed.
news/n7.html: (the TV) He is in the living room now. He is listening to this. ...Go back to bed.

news/n8.say: One more thing before we go. The boy on Larch Road is not alone in the house. ... It has been standing behind him the whole time.
news/n8.html: (the TV) ...the boy on Larch Road is not alone in the house...

mom/gift_a.say: Oh. Here. Gas station had these by the register.
mom/gift_a.html: Mom: Oh. Here. Gas station had these by the register.

mom/gift_b.say: Take pictures of the new place. For Grandma.
mom/gift_b.html: Mom: Take pictures of the new place. For Grandma.

dad/gift.say: Twenty-four pictures. That's all you get.
dad/gift.html: Dad: Twenty-four pictures. That's all you get.

you/box4.html: You: There's another box in my room. It's got my name on it.

dad/box4.say: [flat, quiet] ...That's not one of ours. I'll put it out by the road.
dad/box4.html: Dad: ...That's not one of ours. I'll put it out by the road.

mom/n1_call_a.say: [sweet, sleepy, through a door] Bud? Come here a sec, honey.
mom/n1_call_a.html: Mom: (through their door) Bud? Come here a sec, honey.

mom/n1_call_b.say: [sweet, slow, through a door] Come here. I want to show you something.
mom/n1_call_b.html: Mom: (through their door) Come here. I want to show you something.

mom/n1_door_b.say: [quiet, uneasy] Who were you talking to?
